{"code": "import pandas as pd

# Load the data
file_path = '/home/musel/Github/research_agent/data/sales.csv'
sales = pd.read_csv(file_path)

# Check the revenue column for QA orders: they have commas
print("Sample of revenue values:")
print(sales['revenue'].head(15))

# Identify QA orders using the original string format with commas
qa_orders = sales[sales['revenue'] == '999,999.99']
print(f"Number of QA orders (revenue = '999,999.99'): {len(qa_orders)}")

# Remove QA orders
sales_clean = sales[sales['revenue'] != '999,999.99']

# Convert revenue to float after removing commas
sales_clean['revenue_float'] = sales_clean['revenue'].str.replace(',', '', regex=False).astype(float)

# Filter for completed orders only
completed_orders = sales_clean[sales_clean['status'] == 'completed']

# Compute mean revenue of completed orders
mean_revenue = completed_orders['revenue_float'].mean()
print(f"Mean revenue of completed orders (after removing QA orders): {mean_revenue}")

# Return the value for submission
mean_revenue"}
